title: Pollen packs get stepped grants
summary:
Stepped Pollen packs and a mobile checkout fix landed alongside ten new community app listings.

Checkout now offers six Pollen packs, from $2 for 2.5 Pollen to $100 for 200 Pollen, replacing the blanket 2× bonus for new purchases. Balance and pricing pages reflect the pack-specific grants, and purchase buttons now fit narrow mobile screens.

The community catalog added apps for 3D icons, character prompts, affirmations and goal boards, personalized learning games, vector signatures, and turning YouTube videos into blog posts.

New catalog entries cover AI-tool discovery, website-building reviews, Unity game translation, and Android translation for comics and other reading. The Greenhouse reached 670 apps, and its daily app metrics were refreshed.
